name: Standing Front View
prompt: standing upright while facing the camera directly in a balanced natural posture

name: Standing Back View
prompt: standing with their back toward the camera, showing the complete rear silhouette

name: Three-Quarter Pose
prompt: posed at a three-quarter angle with the torso turned partially away from the camera

name: Contrapposto
prompt: standing in a natural contrapposto pose with weight shifted onto one leg and relaxed asymmetry through the hips and shoulders

name: Sitting Casually
prompt: sitting in a relaxed natural posture with believable weight distribution

name: Cross-Legged
prompt: sitting cross-legged in a comfortable balanced posture

name: Walking Toward Camera
prompt: walking naturally toward the camera in mid-stride with realistic body movement

name: Running
prompt: running in a dynamic mid-stride pose with believable momentum and coordinated limb movement

name: Looking Over Shoulder
prompt: body turned away while looking back over one shoulder toward the camera

name: Leaning Against Wall
prompt: leaning naturally against a wall with relaxed posture and believable contact points
